concepts.title: Purpose, Scope, and Repository Map
concepts.description: CFE is a deliberately simplified conceptual hydrologic model designed to reproduce key National Water Model runoff behaviors behind a BMI interface.

concepts.title: Timestep Data Flow and Water Accounting
concepts.description: The cfe function advances one catchment timestep while explicitly tracking precipitation, evapotranspiration, storage transfers, routed runoff, and mass balance.

concepts.title: Rainfall Partitioning, Ice, and Evapotranspiration
concepts.description: CFE can partition rainfall with Schaake or Xinanjiang logic and can remove atmospheric demand from rainfall, retention storage, and soil.

concepts.title: Soil and Groundwater Reservoirs
concepts.description: A shared conceptual-reservoir structure represents soil and groundwater stores with thresholded, potentially nonlinear outlets.

concepts.title: GIUH and Nash Cascade Routing
concepts.description: CFE delays surface and lateral runoff with explicit queues and reservoir cascades before combining them with groundwater discharge.

concepts.title: BMI Lifecycle and Configuration Contracts
concepts.description: bmi_cfe.c owns allocation, configuration parsing, forcing selection, lifecycle methods, variable metadata, and scalar-grid exchange.

concepts.title: Build, Test, Debug, and Contribute
concepts.description: CMake options select CFE integration modes, CTest exercises BMI behavior, and mass-balance evidence anchors scientific debugging.
